bullets.id: Emas jatuh tajam pada Jumat. Kitco mencatat spot di $3.875,05, turun 3,62% dalam sehari dan 3,74% dalam sepekan, setelah menyentuh $3.870,25, level terlemah dalam lebih dari setahun. USAGold menyebut perak anjlok 5,90% ke $49,09 dan platinum turun 4,22%, dengan penjualan yang tampak didorong pelepasan posisi.
bullets.en: Gold fell sharply on Friday. Kitco had spot at $3,875.05, down 3.62% on the day and 3.74% on the week, after touching $3,870.25, its weakest level in more than a year. USAGold says silver dropped 5.90% to $49.09 and platinum fell 4.22%, in selling that looked driven by deleveraging.

bullets.id: Pemicu utamanya adalah taruhan kenaikan Fed: Trading Economics mencatat peluang sekitar 75% kenaikan Desember menurut CME FedWatch. Ledakan pada sebuah tanker di Selat Hormuz mengangkat Brent ke sekitar $113,43 dan WTI ke $104,12, menambah tekanan inflasi. Yield AS sekitar 4,93% dan indeks dolar 101,96. Emas turun 7,23% dalam sebulan dan sekitar 30,9% di bawah rekor $5.608,35.
bullets.en: The main driver is Fed hike bets: Trading Economics cites about 75% odds of a December hike per CME FedWatch. Explosions on a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz lifted Brent to about $113.43 and WTI to $104.12, adding to inflation pressure. The US yield is about 4.93% and the dollar index 101.96. Gold is down 7.23% on the month and about 30.9% below its $5,608.35 record.

bullets.id: Survei Kitco: 63% analis Wall Street memperkirakan emas turun pekan depan, sementara 53% investor ritel masih memperkirakan naik. Analis melihat zona $3.900–4.000 sudah jebol; target berikutnya disebut di $3.750–3.850, bahkan sekitar $3.500. Agenda pekan depan: ISM manufaktur Senin, pemilu sela AS dan JOLTS Selasa, ADP dan ISM jasa Rabu, Bank of England Kamis, dan data payroll Oktober Jumat.
bullets.en: Kitco’s survey: 63% of Wall Street analysts expect lower gold next week, while 53% of retail investors still expect gains. Analysts see the $3,900–4,000 zone as broken; next targets are cited at $3,750–3,850, or even around $3,500. Next week: ISM manufacturing Monday, the US midterms and JOLTS Tuesday, ADP and ISM services Wednesday, the Bank of England Thursday, and October payrolls Friday.

bullets.id: Harga Antam 1 gram turun Rp20.000 ke Rp2.526.000, penurunan hari ketiga, sementara buyback anjlok Rp65.000 ke Rp2.276.000, sehingga spread melebar ke Rp250.000 (sekitar 9,9%). Galeri24 turun Rp21.000 ke Rp2.478.000 (buyback Rp2.337.000, spread sekitar 5,7%) dan UBS turun Rp23.000 ke Rp2.501.000 (buyback Rp2.312.000, spread sekitar 7,6%). Buyback Galeri24 kini Rp61.000 di atas Antam.
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram price fell Rp20,000 to Rp2,526,000, a third daily decline, while buyback dropped Rp65,000 to Rp2,276,000, widening the spread to Rp250,000 (about 9.9%). Galeri24 fell Rp21,000 to Rp2,478,000 (buyback Rp2,337,000, spread about 5.7%) and UBS fell Rp23,000 to Rp2,501,000 (buyback Rp2,312,000, spread about 7.6%). Galeri24’s buyback is now Rp61,000 above Antam’s.
